notes: The source records page limits unless the court orders otherwise. General motions and responses use the general motion presets. The separate motion and reply presets cover C.R.C.P. 12(b)(1), 12(b)(2), and 56.
The general motion and reply word limits are alternatives to the corresponding page limits, with the same exclusions.
The source did not separately confirm word limits for C.R.C.P. 12(b)(1), 12(b)(2), or 56 motions. Verify before using a word figure for these filings.

rules.notes: The source uses a two-column boxed caption with court and parties on the left and COURT USE ONLY, case number, and division on the right. Supply the address of the court on the docket.

The source records at least 1-inch margins, 12-point type, and double spacing, with exceptions such as footnotes and block quotes. This profile sets Letter paper, one-inch margins, and Times New Roman 12-point double-spaced body text.
The source rule figures and exclusions are in validation. Verify the rule and any applicable court order before choosing a limit.
The source calls for good-faith conferral with opposing counsel before filing most motions. State conferral in the body when required.
The renderer leaves signature and service dates blank for manual completion immediately before filing via Colorado CCEF. The legacy certificate preprints only the year.
Word limits for the listed C.R.C.P. 12 and 56 motion classes were not separately confirmed in the source.
